definition: Market equity plus financial debt, seller/warrant/noncommon claims, NCI and ALL lease liabilities, less unrestricted cash and liquid investments. Book/principal proxies explicitly qualified. Revenue is reported consolidated FY2025, not adjusted net-of-pass-through revenue.
target_lease_proxy_source: FY2025 10-K Note 16 current operating lease balance carried forward as an analyst proxy; June noncurrent balance from integrated model. Stress current proxy +/- 5 million. Not a reported September total.

peers.decision: Qualified: space systems overlap, major defense/autonomy and acquisition differences
peers.limitations: June cash/claims and August shares carried to cutoff; no comprehensive intervening-ATM roll-forward verified. Equity uses issued shares, not options/RSUs. Partial-year Edge Autonomy revenue and one-time charges distort annual multiples/margins. Principal/lease/warrant book values are proxies, not September quotes.

sources.locators: Annual consolidated income statement/segment reconciliation; Q cover issued shares, balance sheet claims, Note B cash/restricted split, Note H gross debt; historical Close column September 10. Filing date verified; no publication hour asserted.

peers.decision: Qualified: Vega launch/Ariane propulsion overlap, European institutional and defense mix differs
peers.limitations: Issued shares less treasury, not weighted-average EPS shares. Pending Advent issuance/proceeds excluded together. Book NCI and lease values are proxies. Cash includes customer advances economically funding operations; full cash subtraction may overstate excess liquidity. Minority investments retained in EV can inflate numerator relative to consolidated revenue. IFRS, pass-through revenue and capitalized development differ from RKLB. Reported EBIT includes its issuer presentation conventions, not adjusted EBIT.

sources.locators: Annual Note 3.28 reported revenues and page 35 reported EBIT; July notice page 2 issued/treasury shares; Sept release cover timestamp, pages 6-7 balance sheet and page 12 net financial debt reconciliation. Close column September 10.
